subject: 56 Wareham Street Historical Significance
overview: The commission determined 56 Wareham Street is historically significant and initiated planning for an archaeological cap at Thomas Brooks Park. The body also recommended a new member to the Mayor to fill an upcoming vacancy.

items.title: 56 Wareham Street Determination of Significance
items.summary: Found 56 Wareham Street historically significant due to its pre-1900 construction and unique stick-style architectural elements despite its current state of repair.

items.title: 69 Court Street Public Hearing
items.summary: Tabled the public hearing for 69 Court Street because the owner failed to meet the mandatory sign posting requirements.

items.title: Thomas Brooks Park Archaeological Cap
items.summary: Discussed the design and functional goals for an archaeological cap at the Thomas Brooks house site and deferred a formal consultation with Peter Hedlund until January.

items.title: Commissioner Recommendation and Vacancy
items.summary: Voted to recommend Eleni Glikas to the Mayor to fill the commission vacancy created by the upcoming departure of Jenny Graham.

items.title: Historical Project Updates and Minutes
items.summary: Reviewed the status of records requests for Cross Street Cemetery, headstone restoration logistics, and grant paperwork; approved the October meeting minutes.
